findings.passage: While the right for the individual citizen to bear arms is a constitional mandate and the intent for it was to allow effective resistance against tyranny, clearly we accept many restrictions on what weapons are reasonable to bear. Automatic weapons are not allowed, nor are shoulder launched surface to air missiles, though it's pretty clear such weapons and more would probably be needed to combat the US Military. I think the current balance is about right and should remain.
findings.note: His written answer to a voter-guide questionnaire item on what gun ownership restrictions are needed for public safety.
